bull_bear.body:
- Lever 02, "A step-change in scale already delivered": "The May 2026 amalgamation lifted consolidated net worth from ₹440 Cr to ₹1,169 Cr — a 2.7x uplift that funds the entire growth agenda without near-term equity dilution."
- The NBFC (the holding company itself, an "RBI-registered Middle Layer NBFC-ICC") "manages proprietary capital across asset classes ... with a focus on liquidity management, capital preservation, and return optimization".
- NBFC capital deployment is across four stated activities: Loans Against Securities, Inter-Corporate Deposits, Long-Term and Short-Term Investments, and Special Situation Transactions; it operates "as a non-deposit-taking NBFC".
bull_bear.title: Capital allocation policy (investor deck)

business.body:
- Describes itself as "A diversified, research driven financial services group" with "10+ Business Divisions", "30+ Years of legacy" and shares "Traded on BSE & NSE"; the stated vision is "To lead the financialization of assets across India through research driven insights and technology driven transparency".
- Investment thesis lever 01 claims it is "One of very few vehicles offering exposure to broking, investment banking, wealth, alternatives and NBFC lending under one roof"; the group cross-sell pitch is that "With a single onboarding, clients can access the full suite of Ashika Group offerings through one trusted relationship".
- Distribution moat framed as "Heritage in Eastern India — 30+ years in the region" plus "Pan India — Extensive outreach in Tier 2/3 cities", i.e. "Three decades of brand equity in the region where demat and mutual fund penetration is lowest".
- Lever 05 frames the client base as "A large, under-monetised client base": "~1.35 lakh clients, ~₹23,400 Cr of assets under advice and 920+ channel partners are today monetised largely through broking. Each new licence is a fresh revenue line on the same acquisition cost."
- Institutional Equities positioned as "a specialised execution and research engine", "Serving 200+ institutional investors and empanelled with 100+ institutions including DIIs, FIIs, AIFs, PMS & Family Offices".
business.title: Positioning (investor deck)

business.body:
- [Name change] The issuer is "Ashika Global Securities Limited (Formerly, Ashika Credit Capital Limited)", CIN L67120WB1994PLC062159, BSE Scrip Code 543766; the deck is the Q1FY27 investor presentation filed 1st August 2026 for the quarter ended 30th June 2026.
- [Amalgamation] A "May 2026 amalgamation" is cited as the source of the net-worth step-up; the deck gives no further detail on the entities merged or the share-exchange terms.
- [AIF CAT III performance] For the Ashika India Select Fund the deck tabulates fund vs Nifty 500 returns — 1 Month 3.7% vs 1.5%, 3 Months 25.6% vs 12.0%, 6 Months 8.4% vs -3.7%, 1 Year 3.4% vs -2.6%, CAGR 2 Years 4.3% vs 1.0%, CAGR Since Inception (31.01.24) 9.5% vs 6.9%, Absolute Since Inception 24.6% vs 17.5% — noted as "based on TWRR as on 30th June 2026 (Pre-tax and post-expenses)" and "not verified by any regulatory authority".
- [Board additions] Independent directors include Mr. Supratim Bandyopadhyay ("Former Chairman of PFRDA, driving a ~4x increase in pension assets to ₹9 trillion during his tenure") and Mr. Pravin Kutumbe ("Former CFO & CIO at LIC").
- [Internal contradiction] Channel-partner count is given as "950+" on the overview and broking pages but as "920+ channel partners" in Investment Thesis lever 05; both readings are reproduced here rather than reconciled.
business.title: Notable from the deck

deepdive.thesis: The deck positions Ashika Global Securities Ltd. (formerly Ashika Credit Capital Ltd.) as a listed, research-driven diversified financial services group — "One Gateway, Every Product" — offering exposure to broking, investment/merchant banking, wealth and family office, alternatives (AIFs) and NBFC lending under one roof, described as "A listed pure-play on India's financialisation".
